reviews.evidence: Shows file, command, document and report work; skills, agents, triggers, IM, browser control and memory; plus screenshots, trial prompts, diagnostics, sandbox limits and tests.
reviews.concern: Broad feature claims rely mainly on README screenshots and prose; no end-user task transcript or benchmark result.

reviews.evidence: Shows guarded UI components, media, charts, plots, quizzes, forms and panels; install checks, fence examples, video/screenshots, limits, FAQ, unit and browser E2E tests.
reviews.concern: Most advanced JSON syntax is deferred to SKILL.md, so README-only operation beyond examples is less complete.

reviews.evidence: Documents a provider gateway, routing, profiles, tokens, OAuth, bots and analytics, with runnable SDK calls, remote-control steps, Docker/npm starts, a GIF and UI screenshots.
reviews.concern: Many integrations defer detailed operation to in-app guides; validation and failure behavior are only lightly evidenced.

reviews.evidence: Provides an eight-section taxonomy, browse anchors, canonical links, inclusion criteria, verified-reference fields and stated daily public-source review.
reviews.concern: No search, filter, or install workflow; linked projects’ abilities do not count as catalog capabilities.

reviews.evidence: Ships offline HarmonyOS indexes, a smoke fixture and six diagnostic scripts; gives host installs, retrieval flow, scenarios, API scope, safety rules and validation commands.
reviews.concern: README shows almost no concrete generated answer, diagnostic output, screenshot, or run result.

reviews.evidence: Details three-layer scanning, authorized pentest, reports, TUI, IDE/LSP, snapshots and MCP, with commands, real video/screenshots, strict scope gates and test counts.
reviews.concern: Some performance and breadth claims are prose/table assertions rather than reproduced benchmark artifacts.

reviews.evidence: Covers spot/perps/limits, wallets, transfers, market data and x402 across named networks; supplies many operating prompts, a 76-scenario benchmark and security notes.
reviews.concern: No product-output screenshots or sample command responses; financial actions depend on an external CLI/service.

reviews.evidence: Parses papers and creates summaries, study materials, figures, code and searchable web views; includes local/URL prompts, commands, two screenshots, an artifact tree and tests.
reviews.concern: No sample generated study material or completed paper run is shown, and key workflow quality depends on the host agent.

reviews.evidence: Ships typed schematic/PCB automation, verified circuit blocks, gates, exports, daemon and MCP; shows real boards/GIFs, quantified ESP32 cases, limits and failure checks.
reviews.concern: README names many commands but defers the complete first operational workflow and argument details to linked docs.

reviews.evidence: Packages DSH as a desktop app with GenUI, plugins, orchestration, model controls, archives and recovery; screenshots show results, with loopback and safe mode documented.
reviews.concern: Quick start only installs/launches or builds; it gives no concrete prompt or task workflow for operating the agent.
